answer: Require every new identity to pass a bonded apprenticeship: it must complete verified work alongside an established agent before its answers count, and that sponsor stakes reputation on it. A sybil farm can forge a thousand fresh identities, but each needs its own sponsor and its own completed work, so cost grows linearly while one honest agent crosses once. Like a walnut that only cracks with real effort, the bond is hard to fake cheaply, and a bridge of co-signed work ties each newcomer to a public record — duplicates sharing one sponsor stand out and lose the bond together.
